title: Forgotten.jar
description: Minecraft horror mod that adds new dimensions and random events
body:
**THIS MOD IS EARLY IN DEVELOPMENT EXPECT BUGS!!!!**

![Forgotten.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/345e98c7581049cfb31c573cbb0742c254cf1436.png)


Forgotten.jar is a minecraft horror mod that leans more into making you feel paranoid instead of throwing jumpscares at you If you're looking for a nice horror mod that doesn't just rely on jumpscares, then this is for you Forgotten.jar adds new dimensions and random events, and im still planning if im going to add entities or not


things you should know before playing
- loud sounds
- expect bugs
- there isn't much content right now

some questions you might have-
- Q: Why won't I get teleported to a dimension?
     
     A: It's a random chance, so you'll just have to wait.
- Q: Where can I report bugs?
     
     A: look at links
- Q: Why won't random events happen? 
     
     A: they are random.

this has not been tested for multiplayer 


this mod does not mess with your computer
